svg.title: The Hoffman Agency Design System
svg.desc: Three bands on navy. The pitch: the stretched hello in the brand colours, "Point an LLM here. Ship things that stay on brand.", and the agency line — an integrated comms agency that helps tech brands solve hard business problems, the harder the better. The tour, running: four screens of the 23-screen interactive brand tour. What is inside: the palette, the two typefaces, 75 Fluent emoji, 49 photographs, 36 illustrations, 1,595 icons, 48 slide layouts, 76 hand-drawn marks and 16 offices.
svg.text: DESIGN SYSTEM · 48 SLIDE LAYOUTS · A 23-SCREEN INTERACTIVE TOUR · 49 PHOTOGRAPHS
THE TOUR, RUNNING · 23 SCREENS YOU PRESS, DRAG AND BREAK · templates/brand-tour/
